samples.text: Thirdly, we should urgently create smart global governance frameworks with a long-term vision for science and technology, especially emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence. That will ensure we make progress and enjoy the benefits of those technologies, while actively preventing threats to peace, sustainable development and humankind. In that connection, I welcome the documents adopted at the Summit for the Future, especially the Global Digital Compact (resolution 79/1, annex I). That will serve as a crucial basis for advancing global governance and international cooperation in those areas.
States to ensure the reliability and security of artificial intelligence (resolution 78/265), in a significant step forward.
